name: Sobo-Katamuki Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Sobo and Katamuki peaks, the 'mountains of the gods' of the Oita-Miyazaki border, with the Takachiho gorge and shrine country.
notes: Managed by Oita/Miyazaki. The Sobo trail and Takachiho's gorge are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
